preferences: Use Paseo -> OpenCode with the oh-my-openagent plugin enabled as the execution and session-management layer.
Do not use opencode --pure; external plugins must load.
Never select opencode/* Zen models or opencode-go/* models. Prefer QwenCloud, OmniRoute, and OpenAI/Codex routes.
Use QwenCloud for implementation and UI, OmniRoute for research and free routing, and OpenAI/Codex routes for planning and audit.
Load QwenCloud and OmniRoute credentials from ~/.zshrc.local; never track secrets in the repository.
Do not silently switch providers after authentication, billing, or model errors; report the exact blocker.
Prefer bounded worktrees and require independent diff and test verification before claiming completion.
